## Summary

I replaced the string membership tier with a numeric `membershipLevel` (1–3), computed at creation.

**`src/main/resources/openapi.yml`** — Replaced the `membershipTier` (string) property on the `Owner` schema with `membershipLevel` (integer, min 1, max 3). This drives regeneration of `OwnerDto`, removing `membershipTier` from the response in favour of `membershipLevel`.

**`OwnerMapper.java`** — Replaced `membershipTier(Owner)` with `membershipLevel(Owner)`, implementing the new rule: start at 1, +1 when an email is present, +1 when `namesakeCount` is 0, capped at 3 (level 4 reserved for tenure). The `@Mapping` target was updated accordingly. Household size no longer influences the value (the old GOLD-tier behaviour is gone).

**`OwnerRestControllerV1.java`** — The create audit line now records `membershipLevel=` (derived from the mapped DTO) instead of nothing tier-related; I moved the DTO mapping just above the audit call so the level is available. Also removed the now-stale comment about a 3-member household promoting to the GOLD tier.

Notably, `Cp23` confirms the behavioural change: a 3-member household member with no email and no namesakes is now level 2 (previously it would have been GOLD).
